current_example.problem: The vector $\mathbf{a}$ is directed due north-east and $|\mathbf{a}|=11.$ The vector $\mathbf{b}$ is directed due south-east and $|\mathbf{b}|=8.$ Find the exact value of $|\mathbf{a}+\textbf{b}|.$
current_example.worked_solution:
We use the triangle law of addition to find the sum $\mathbf{a}+\mathbf{b}\mathbin{:}$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251309/assets/a122c2a1146f27a089f991f7e0bd07e4180ca4622bfc95a6b85afc83f339c11d.png)

Notice that we obtain a right triangle. So, we can use Pythagorean theorem as follows: 

$$
\begin{aligned}|a+\text{b}{|}^{2} & ={|a|}^{2}+{|b|}^{2} \\  & ={11}^{2}+{8}^{2} \\  & =185\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $|\mathbf{a}+\textbf{b}|=\sqrt{185}.$
